name: launchday
problem: Most good open-source projects launch badly and get ignored
promise: A launch plan you can run in an evening

features.title: A launch score out of 100
features.detail: Flags a vague opening line, no demo, no install command and leaked secrets

features.title: Checks your name before you ship
features.detail: Looks for collisions on GitHub, crates.io, npm, PyPI and Homebrew

features.title: Launch posts you copy and paste
features.detail: Show HN, Reddit and X posts, with a schedule in your time zone
